error.message: YouTube требует вход с IP GitHub Actions. Добавьте cookies в секрет YTDLP_COOKIES или выберите SoundCloud.
error.detail: ERROR: [youtube] 02xULKxBLI0: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot. This helps protect our community. Use --cookies-from-browser or --cookies for the authentication. See  https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#how-do-i-pass-cookies-to-yt-dlp  for how to manually pass cookies. Also see  https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies  for tips on effectively exporting YouTube cookies
